name: Grayscale Filter
author: ShaderStudio
description: Converts incoming RGB color to luminance grayscale using perceptual weights.
glsl: vec3 filterGrayscale(vec3 c, float i) { float g = dot(c, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114)); return mix(c, vec3(g), i); }
wgsl: fn filterGrayscale(c: vec3<f32>, i: f32) -> vec3<f32> { let g = dot(c, vec3<f32>(0.299, 0.587, 0.114)); return mix(c, vec3<f32>(g), i); }
